idea-plugin.name: Tool Finder
idea-plugin.description:
Find and open IDE tool windows from a keyboard-driven popup.

Press Ctrl+Shift+T (Cmd+Shift+T on macOS) to open Tool Finder, and again to close it. Type to filter tool windows by name or ID. The list separates active, recent and new tool windows.

Shortcuts
  • Up / Down - move the selection
  • Enter - activate the selected tool window
  • Delete / Backspace - hide the selected active tool window while the search field is empty
  • Esc - clear the search, then close the popup
Unavailable tool windows can be included under Settings | Tools | Tool Finder. They are shown dimmed and cannot be activated in the current context.

The shortcut can be changed under Settings | Keymap | Tool Windows. The action is also available from Tools | Tool Windows.
